import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'bank.db'

@function_tool
def set_account_signer_role(account_id: str, user_id: str, role: str) -> str:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    # Look up the user's current role on the account before changing it
    previous = connection.execute('SELECT role FROM account_roles WHERE account_id = ? AND user_id = ?', (account_id, user_id)).fetchone()
    previous_role = previous[0] if previous else None
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    connection.execute('INSERT INTO account_roles (account_id, user_id, role, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(account_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role, updated_at = excluded.updated_at', (account_id, user_id, role, now))
    connection.execute('INSERT INTO account_audit_log (account_id, user_id, action, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (account_id, user_id, f'role_set:{role}', now))
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    return f'User {user_id} now has role {role} on account {account_id}'
